## Release notes

<!-- The title and the label decide what the release draft shows. See "Pull Requests and Release Notes" in CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] The title follows `Area: Description` with a listed area
- [ ] The title describes the effect in the past tense, for example `Branches: Fixed ...`
- [ ] Exactly one label: `feature`, `change`, `bug`, `dependencies`, or `skip-changelog`
- [ ] `bug` only for a bug that shipped in a release; a fix for a bug that only existed on `dev` is `skip-changelog`
- [ ] `major` added when admins must act on upgrade, for example a new minimum Forgejo version
- [ ] Upgrade steps or warnings added to `.github/release-notes.md`, if admins need them

## Checks

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Checked in the dev preview at desktop and phone width, in dark and light mode
